title: The Super Mouse puts a touchscreen macro pad under your hand
summary: A company called Arctic Fox Technologies has announced a new multifunction mouse that forgoes a myriad of customizable shortcut buttons peppered across its surface for a compact touchscreen sitting beneath your hand. The Super Mouse may not prioritize ergonomics with its boxy design, but it can replace other peripherals on your desk, like a trackpad, […]
llm_summary: Arctic Fox Technologies’ new “Super Mouse” swaps the usual array of physical shortcut buttons for a small, built‑in touchscreen that sits under your palm, letting you trigger macros, scroll, and even act as a trackpad. While its boxy shape isn’t the most ergonomic, the device aims to consolidate several desk peripherals into a single, customizable mouse.
